name: labeliq-app
description: LabelIQ portal prototype for consumer, business, and legal compliance workflows.

scripts.check: find src scripts -name '*.js' -o -name '*.py' | sort | xargs -I {} sh -c 'case "{}" in *.js) node --check "{}" ;; *.py) python3 -m py_compile "{}" ;; esac' && node --check server.js
